title: Anti-War Congress - Foreign Languages Research Society

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / File No. B. REGISTRY. / No. D 5393 / Special Branch-S.2 station / Date October 30, 1935）
Subject (in full) Anti-War Congress - "Foreign Languages Research Society."
Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**
The Foreign Languages' Research Society, or as it is often known, the Shanghai Foreign Languages College, came into existence about ten weeks ago following, and as the result of, several discussions held by certain prominent Chinese.
The person responsible for the inauguration of this society is a young Chinese male named Newton Mei ( 梅 耐 冬 ), who describes himself as Dean of the Shanghai Foreign Languages College. Mr. Mei is a former student of the Peiping University, through which institution he graduated in 1929. This individual, it is said, together with Wang Chen Ming (Dr. C.T. Wang) ( 王 正 廷 ), ex-Minister of Foreign Affairs, Ma Siang Pah ( 马 相 伯 ), the doyen of Chinese scholars and educationalists, Tsai Iung Hsiang ( 蔡 元 培 ), a former president of the China National Government University at Peiping, and Liu Hua Zai ( 刘 华 瑞 ), an ex-Secretary to the Chinese delegation to the League of Nations at Geneva, who returned from Europe during the current year, conceived the idea of establishing throughout China clubs where interested Chinese might study foreign languages and eventually be prepared for entry into foreign business circles in the Far East..
Following this it was decided to establish a school in Shanghai, which, while teaching general subjects, would pay special attention to the study of foreign tongues.
In the early part of August of this year, a small room in the Asia Middle School, which is adjacent to the Japanese Public School, North Szechuen Road, was employed for nearly three weeks by representatives of the Shanghai Foreign Languages College for purposes of advertising their aims and objects in the vernacular press and for enrolling pupils.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 档案号 B. 登记处 / 编号 D 5393 / 特别支部-S.2 分站 / 日期 1935年10月30日）
主题（全称）反战大会 - “外语研究会”。
撰写人：D.S. Pitts。转呈人：**〔此处转录不清〕**
外语研究会，或如其常被称为的上海外语学院，是在某些知名华人举行多次讨论之后，并作为这些讨论的结果，于大约十周前成立的。
负责发起该会的人士是一位名为梅耐冬（Newton Mei）的年轻华籍男子，他自称为上海外语学院院长。梅氏曾是北京大学的学生，并于1929年从该校毕业。据说，此人与前外交部长王正廷博士（Wang Chen Ming (Dr. C.T. Wang)）、中国学者和教育界泰斗马相伯（Ma Siang Pah）、前北平国立大学校长蔡元培（Tsai Iung Hsiang），以及今年从欧洲回国的、曾任中国出席日内瓦国际联盟代表团秘书的刘华瑞（Liu Hua Zai），共同构思了在中国各地建立俱乐部的想法，以便让感兴趣的华人学习外语，并最终为进入远东的外国商界做好准备。
随后，决定在上海建立一所学校，该校在教授普通科目的同时，将特别注意外语的学习。
今年8月上旬，位于北四川路日本公立学校旁边的亚洲中学的一间小房间，被上海外语学院的代表使用了近三周，用于在华文报刊上宣传其宗旨和目标，并招收学生。

In the latter part of August, premises situated at Nos.
17, 18 and 19 Magnolia Terrace, North Szechuen Road were leased
by this institution for the accomodation of the newly established
school, which then commenced to function.
At present there are between 170 and 180 Chinese pupils,
male and female, attending this college, which in addition to
teaching general subjects such as mathematics, Chinese, history
and geography, specialises in the study of the English, German,
French, Japanese, Russian and Esperanto tongues.
Of the total number of pupils, some 60 or 70 are boarders.
The school is divided into three grades - Primary, Middle, and
Higher - students paying $15, $25 and $30 per term as fees
according to the grade in which they study. In addition, the
resident pupils pay $48 per quarter for board and lodging.
Six scholars are at present studying Russian under the
tutorship of one Wang Chi Kyuin, a Chinese male who formerly
was a merchant in Harbin, where during a stay of seven years,
he learnt Russian. It is said that this person was previously
connected with the "World's Students' Club" situated in Chinese
Territory and that formerly he was a teacher in a Russian school
in the French Concession.
A Portuguese subject named A.M. Ritchie is employed at the
college as an overseer or an inspector, his duties consisting
of supervising the cleansing of the premises, observing that the
scholars pay due attention to all school rules and maxims, and
teaching English to the younger and more backward pupils.
Another foreigner, an American lady whose name has not been
ascertained, is also employed at this institution to teach
English to the senior students. The remainder of the teachers

8月下旬，该机构租赁了位于北四川路木兰里（Magnolia Terrace）17、18和19号的房屋，以容纳新成立的学校，该校随即开始运作。
目前，就读于该学院的华籍男女学生约有170至180人。该学院除教授数学、中文、历史和地理等普通科目外，还专门研究英语、德语、法语、日语、俄语和世界语。
在学生总数中，约有60或70人是寄宿生。学校分为初级、中级和高级三个年级，学生根据所读年级每学期分别缴纳15元、25元和30元的学费。此外，寄宿学生每季度需缴纳48元的膳宿费。
目前有六名学生在王吉钦（Wang Chi Kyuin，音译）的指导下学习俄语。王是一名华籍男子，此前曾在哈尔滨经商，在那里居住的七年期间学会了俄语。据说此人此前曾与位于华界的“世界学生俱乐部”有关联，且以前曾是法租界一所俄语学校的教师。
一名名为 A.M. Ritchie 的葡萄牙籍人士受雇于该学院，担任监学或视察员，其职责包括监督场所的清洁工作，确保学生严格遵守所有校规和准则，并向年幼及程度较差的学生教授英语。
另一名外籍人士，一位姓名尚未查明的美国女士，也受雇于该机构，向高年级学生教授英语。其余教师

    are Chinese and they are responsible for the teaching to the
students of German, French, Japanese, Esperanto and Russian.
    According to information received the authorities of
this college, which will later be registered with the Ministry
of Education, have a very ambitious programme for its future
development. Larger and more commodious premises, including
playing grounds, will later be acquired, and it is intended in
the near future to employ several foreign teachers to instruct
the scholars in the above mentioned languages. Attempts will
also be made to interest foreign and Chinese notables in this
institution and later to induce them to visit the college for
the purpose of addressing the pupils on various subjects.
    Enquiries indicate that the management of this college
aver that no political ideals at all are entertained and that
the students are discouraged from holding such beliefs. This,
however, is thought to be the natural outcome of the arrest of
the late treasurer of the school - Zung Pih Tien (陳碧天). -
on October 18, 1933 by officers of the Shanghai Bureau of Public
Safety on a charge of being a member of a communistic organis-
ation.

                                            J. A. Giles

    均为华人，他们负责向学生教授德语、法语、日语、世界语和俄语。
    根据收到的消息，该学院的管理层计划在未来进行宏大的发展，该学院稍后将在教育部注册。将来将购置更大、更宽敞的校舍，包括运动场地，并打算在不久的将来聘请几名外籍教师，用上述语言指导学生。还将尝试引起外国和华人名流对该机构的兴趣，并随后邀请他们访问学院，就各种主题向学生发表演讲。
    调查显示，该学院的管理层声称绝不抱有任何政治理想，并且不鼓励学生持有此类信念。然而，这被认为是对该校前司库陈碧天（Zung Pih Tien）被捕一事的自然反应。陈碧天于1933年10月18日被上海市公安局警员以涉嫌加入共产主义组织的罪名逮捕。
